description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M). Single change: qkv shape goes NAP=4,tph=256 -> NAP=3,tph=512. Param-matched: 6*256*16*128 = 6*512*8*128 = 3.15M/L (unchanged). Bandwidth doubles (768 KB/L -> 1536 KB/L per layer). Wide-vs-deep test for qk_lut: more tables, fewer rows per table. Prior memory says wide-shape beats deep for residual_lut but was net-negative for qk_lut at exp611 scale; tests if it still holds at exp696 scale. exp698 (NAP=3,tph=256) had lost ~11 mb vs exp696; with double tph, capacity is restored and we see if shape matters at fixed params. Refs: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M, exp698 (killed step 6600)=1.4510.
